messages:
Ava: Pinging y'all. Platform just merged the design doc to move batching decisions server-side and remove client `batch_size`/`batch_window` knobs. High-level plan: 6mo deprecation, backward-compat shim, canary. Want SDKs to carry a telemetry header so we can measure delta.

Joon: Sounds sensible. Centralized batching should give us better packing and lower p99 token cost. Biggest risk is user apps that rely on deterministic, per-request latency.

Lina: UX note: console needs to show which requests used server-managed batching vs client-managed. Otherwise support tickets will blow up. Can we add a per-tenant switch in the Console?

Raj: We should avoid forcing a semver-major unless absolutely necessary. Implement shim in patch/minor where SDKs accept the old args but emit header `x-rw-client-batching: legacy` and a normalized `x-rw-batch-hint`. Then warn in logs.

Omar: Proposal for header format: `x-rw-batch-hint: v1;size=8;window_ms=20`. Keeps parsing simple. Also add `x-rw-client-batching: legacy|shim|none`.

Sophie: From product: implement a 10% canary, gather per-route metrics (P50/P95 latency, tokens per request, cost estimate). Add a dashboard tile that compares baseline vs server-batched. This helps CS explain impacts.

Ava: Example migration shim for TS clients (inline):

```ts
// legacy usage
const client = new RedwoodClient({ batch_size: 8, batch_window: 20 });

// runtime shim sends both legacy config and normalized header
client.request({
  prompt,
  headers: {
    'x-rw-client-batching': 'legacy',
    'x-rw-batch-hint': 'v1;size=8;window_ms=20'
  }
});
```

Joon: Nice. Add a runtime warning on init: "Client batching parameters are deprecated and will be removed in 6 months. See <link>". That keeps it non-breaking.

Lina: For Console copy: "Switch to Platform-managed batching (recommended) — central batching improves global efficiency and reduces per-token cost. Keep legacy batching only for strict single-request latency guarantees." Tooltip should link to perf dashboard and migration guide.

Raj: Telemetry sampling: capture 100% of legacy-header flows for the first 30 days, then drop to 5% thereafter. Emit event `client_batching_transition` with fields: sdk, sdk_version, tenant, route, hint, latency_ms, tokens_out, server_batched(boolean).

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary: feature-flag platform-batching => rollout 2024-08-10T14:00Z to 10% tenants.

Omar: SDK release plan suggestion:
- Patch: add header + logging warning (no API change)
- Minor: add opt-in config `platform_batching: true/false` that maps to header (still preserves legacy fields)
- Major: remove legacy fields after migration window

Sophie: Also schedule a customer comms plan: emails + in-console notice for tenants using legacy knobs. We should surface the dashboard tile in notices for top 50 customers first.

Ava: Action items: 1) I will draft migration KB + example snippets for py/ts/go. 2) Joon + Raj, can you own the SDK shims? 3) Lina, work with product marketing on banner + tooltip. 4) Omar, define header spec PR. 5) Sophie, coordinate canary and dashboard scope.

Raj: I'll take shim for Go + telemetry events.

Joon: I'll do TS and help with test matrix.

Lina: I'll write the banner copy and mockups.

Omar: PR for header spec in ~24hrs.

Sophie: Canaries + dashboard scope, I'll sync with ops.

Ava: Extra: please add an e2e smoke that validates the legacy header during canary (so platform owners can detect missing headers). Also add a console metric that counts tenants still sending legacy header.

Joon: Will add smoke and unit tests to SDK CI.

Raj: One caveat: some customers self-host SDKs or vendored versions. We'll track via `sdk_version` and send targeted comms.

Ava: Makes sense. I'll create the tracking ticket and label it `migration/centralized-batching`. Link: https://redwood-internal.example/boards/4567 (WIP).

Sophie: 👍 Adding CS runbook to explain diagnosing latency spikes post-switch.

Ava: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after the header spec PR lands. :thumbsup:
